questions.question: Which stage initiates infection?
questions.explanation: Infection follows ingestion of fertile eggs containing developed larvae.

questions.question: Which organ is part of larval migration?
questions.explanation: Larvae pass through the lungs before being swallowed back into the intestine.

questions.question: What does a decorticated egg lack?
questions.explanation: Decorticated Ascaris eggs lack the outer mammillated layer.
